FIRST RIDE & HANDLING Before You Ride • Ensure the battery is charged. • Check brakes, tire pressure & mirrors. • Make sure the side stand is up. While Riding • Gradually accelerate for smooth performance. • Maintain a safe distance from other vehicles. • Follow traffic rules & always wear a helmet. Parking the Vehicle • Stop the vehicle completely. • Engage the centre/side stand. • Turn off the vehicle & remove the key. Always remember 1, 2 & 3 before riding. 1 2 3 MCB OFF/ON Ignition OFF/ON Power OFF/ON Inside the Glove box Below LED Cluster RH Combi Switch Note: 1) If the cluster and lights are not turning on, check the MCB and push it down to activate. 2) Fully insert the key into the ignition slot and turn it to the right to power on. 3) To start riding, push the Power switch down. 04

CHARGING THE BATTERY Before your first ride, fully charge the battery. Charging Steps: • Turn off the vehicle and place it on the center stand. Locate the charging port under the front seat. Insert the charger plug into the vehicle's charging port, then connect the charger to a 220V AC power outlet. Monitor the charging status on the charger. • Blinking Red Light: Charging in progress • Solid Red Light: Fully charged. Disconnect the charger once charging is complete. Connect The Charger Blinking Red Light Solid Red light Under The Rider Seat Charging In Progress Fully Charged Never charge near flammable materials or expose to water and direct sunlight. Check that the charging connector lock is properly engaged and makes a ‘click’ sound. For safety and to maintain warranty coverage, only use the charger provided with your Quanta S / S+. Note: 1) Always monitor your battery status and maintain a 80-100% State of Charge (SOC), when not in use. 2) Going on a holiday for more than three days? Park your Quanta S / S+ on the centre stand in a shaded area and ensure it's charged to at least 80% before leaving. 05

POWERING ON THE VEHICLE QUANTA S / S+ is now ready to ride. If the vehicle does not start: • Check the battery charge level. • Ensure the emergency cut-off switch (MCB) is in the correct position. Note: Any issues, always contact the customer support team to rectify and resolve. 05 Vehicle DO’s & DON’Ts

VEHICLE – DO’s & DON’Ts DO’s Make sure the charger is securely attached to the charging port, and the other end is plugged into a properly functioning socket that is free from dust and debris. Always maintain a State of Charge % (SOC%) between 20-80% for optimal battery health. Always Park the vehicle on the centre stand and in a shaded area, even while charging. If leaving your Quanta S / S+ unused for more than three days, charge it up to at least 85% before storage (Recommended 100%). Vehicle washing should be carried out at authorized service station. Always contact Gravton’s authorized service providers for maintenance or troubleshooting. DON’Ts Refrain from driving the vehicle when the charge drops below 20%, as it may affect battery lifespan. Ensure the charging connectors are clean and use only the authorized charger to prevent damage. Do not carry your charger while riding, as vibrations may impact its electronics and cause malfunctioning. Avoid tampering with the electronics and wiring for troubleshooting to prevent potential issues. Leaving the vehicle and battery for prolonged time might affect the life of the battery. Safety Information • Double the helmets, double the safety: Always wear helmet while riding and ensure that the pillion rider also wears one for their safety. • License to unlimited thrill (safely!): Let only licensed riders get behind the wheel for everyone's peace of mind. • Stay on top of your charge! Regularly check your battery level and locate the closest charging station for a quick top-up. • Be the change you want to see. Lead by following the rules and promoting safe riding. • Park smart, park protected: Find a place with shade and a flat surface to park your Quanta S+. • Avoid parking the vehicle in water-logged areas. Make sure the water never enters through the base plate, as it can lead to short circuits. • Do not overload: Never load your Quanta S+ with more than the specified limit of 150 kg. • Avoid carrying flammable material for your own safety as well as others. • Your safety is the first priority: Avoid tinkering with electrical components and wiring. Charging your Quanta S+ • Align the connector with the vehicle’s charging port. Insert the connector firmly into the charging port until it locks into place with a click sound. Refer to the picture showing the connector. • Once charging is complete, turn off the charger or Charging disconnect it from the power source. Connector • Turn the release latch on the connector and gently pull it out from the charging port. Caution: Handle with care. Keep the connector dry, avoid heat, and do not force or tamper with it. Ensure a secure connection and safely unplug after use. Main Circuit Breaker (MCB) The MCB is designed to protect the electrical system and prevent battery drain during extended periods of inactivity of your Quanta S+. To start the vehicle, turn ON the MCB by pushing the trigger down. Usage Instructions: • Turn off the MCB if the vehicle is parked for more than 2 days. • Ensure the MCB is turned back on before starting the vehicle. Caution: Avoid operating MCB with wet hands. Frequently asked questions
Gravton Quanta – FAQs

General Information

Q: What is the top speed of Quanta ?

A: The top speed of Quanta is 75 km/hr in Sport Mode.

Q: What is the certified range?

A: The certified range is up to 125 km in Eco Mode under standard test conditions.

Q: What riding modes are available?

A: Quanta S offers three riding modes: Eco (40 km/hr), Power (55 km/hr), and Sport (75km/hr).

Q: What is the battery capacity?

A: The vehicle comes with a 2.78 kWh LMFP battery.

Q: What motor does Quanta use?

A: It uses a 3 kW BLDC hub motor delivering 172 Nm torque at the wheel.

Q: What is the charging time?

A: Charging time is approximately 5.4 hours from 0% to 100% and 3 hours from 20% to30%.

Charging & Battery

Q: Can I use any charger?

A: No. Only the manufacturer-recommended portable charger should be used.

Q: How often should I charge the battery?

A: Charge to at least 85% every 14 days and avoid draining below 20–30%.

Q: What precautions should I take while charging?

A: Keep the connector dry, avoid heat exposure, ensure secure connection, and switch OFF MCB if parked for more than 2 days.

Q: Is the battery waterproof?

A: Avoid water exposure above the vehicle base plate level.

Display & Indicators

Q: What does the Vehicle Running Green Indicator mean?

A: It confirms the vehicle is powered ON and ready to ride.

Q: What does the Low Battery Indicator mean?

A: Battery level is low and needs immediate charging.

Q: What does the Side Stand Indicator mean?

A: The side stand is deployed. Retract it before riding.

Q: What does the Service Indicator mean?

A: The vehicle is due for maintenance. Visit an authorized service center.

Q: What does the Motor Over Temperature icon indicate?

A: The motor is overheating. Reduce speed and allow it to cool down.

Smart Features

Q: What is GOTAC?

A: GOTAC (Gravton Over The Air Communication) enables vehicle tracking, notifications,personalization, and performance monitoring.

Q: How do I use the Gravton Smart App?

A: Login using your mobile number and OTP, add your vehicle using VIN, and complete dealer verification.

Safety & Usage

Q: What is the maximum load capacity?

A: Maximum recommended load is 150 kg.

Q: What tire pressure should be maintained?

A: Front: 34 psi \| Rear: 40 psi.

Q: Is the storage waterproof?

A: No. Glove box and under-seat storage are not water-resistant.

Warranty & Maintenance

Q: What is the warranty coverage?

A: Motor, Controller, and Battery are covered for 3 years or 30,000 km (whichever comesfirst).

Q: What is not covered under warranty?

A: Normal wear & tear, unauthorized modifications, water damage, misuse, racing usage,and natural calamities.

Q: Is warranty transferable?

A: No, the warranty is non-transferable.

Q: How often should I service the vehicle?

A: Service intervals are recommended at 1000 km, 2500 km, 7500 km, 12500 km, and17500 km.

Q: What happens if I service outside authorized centers?

A: Warranty becomes void if serviced outside authorized Gravton service centers.
Gravton Doorstep Service – FAQs

1\. What is Gravton Doorstep Service?

Gravton Doorstep Service allows Quanta owners to get vehicle inspection, maintenance, and minor repairs done at their home or workplace without visiting a service center.

2\. Is doorstep service available for all Gravton vehicles?

Doorstep service is currently available for Gravton Quanta S owners, depending on serviceavailability in the customer’s location.

3\. What services are covered under Doorstep Service?

General vehicle inspection, brake inspection and adjustments, electrical system checks(horn, indicators, lights), charging system inspection, battery health check, and minortroubleshooting or diagnostics.

4\. Are all repairs possible through Doorstep Service?

Doorstep service supports basic maintenance and minor repairs. For major repairs or component replacement, the vehicle may need to be taken to an authorized Gravton servicecenter.

5\. Is there any charge for Doorstep Service?

Doorstep service may be free within a specified distance from the dealership during eligibleservice periods. Additional charges may apply for locations beyond the coverage area.

6\. How do I book a Doorstep Service?

You can book a service through Gravton Customer Support, an authorized Gravton dealer, orthe Gravton Customer Smart App if your vehicle is linked to the app.

7\. How much time does a doorstep service visit take?

A standard inspection or basic maintenance service usually takes around 30–60 minutesdepending on the type of service required.

8\. What should I keep ready before the technician arrives?

Ensure the vehicle is parked on a flat surface, keep the vehicle key and charger ready if required, ensure sufficient battery charge for diagnostics, and make sure the MCB switch isturned ON.

9\. What if my vehicle shows a fault code or warning indicator?

If the dashboard shows a fault icon or system alert, avoid changing settings and contactGravton service support for assistance.

10\. Will doorstep service affect my warranty?

No. If the service is performed by authorized Gravton technicians, your warranty remainsvalid. Repairs done outside authorized service centers may void the warranty.

11\. When should I schedule my service?

Recommended periodic maintenance intervals include 1000 km / 1.5 months, 2500 km /3.5 months, and 7500 km and beyond.
